title: Personal Budget and Expense Tracker
objective: Track income, expenses and remaining budget.

milestones.title: Expense categories and monthly totals
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate expense categories and monthly totals with the supplied synthetic data.
Compare the result with an independent expectation and test one edge case.

milestones.title: Budget limits and overspending warnings
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate budget limits and overspending warnings with the supplied synthetic data.
Compare the result with an independent expectation and test one edge case.

milestones.title: Charts and monthly summary
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate charts and monthly summary with the supplied synthetic data.
Compare the result with an independent expectation and test one edge case.

stretch_features: Add an error/empty-data state and an accessibility review.
tests_and_acceptance: Every required feature can be demonstrated from a fresh test copy.
Key totals/results reconcile to source records and at least two calculations are checked independently.
Blank, duplicate, invalid or threshold-boundary inputs are tested where relevant.
Keyboard access, readable labels, chart descriptions and number formats are checked.
Setup, assumptions, refresh, security, compatibility, and known limitations are documented.

rubric.description: Core outputs match requirements and normal/error cases are addressed.
Ranges, references, data types, row counts and totals are independently verified.
Raw inputs, calculations and outputs are clear, consistent and auditable.
Workbook is reviewed for keyboard use, labels, access and target-version dependencies.
Expected/actual evidence, setup, limitations and recovery instructions are provided.

review_method: Human review of the actual workbook and its test evidence; automated CodeLeaf text checks do not inspect .xlsx artifacts or execute Excel.
